crossRefs.note: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and Yahweh was with him.
And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him…
The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.

“Your own wickedness will correct you, and your backsliding will rebuke you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil…

translations.web: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
translations.bsb: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the faithless is difficult.
translations.kjv: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
translations.asv: Good understanding giveth favor; But the way of the transgressor is hard.
